items.title: LymphNode: A Plug-and-Play Access Control Method for Deep Neural Networks
items.summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are high-value intellectual property (IP), yet deploying them to edge environments exposes them to \textbf{unrestricted oracle access}, rendering them vulnerable to model extraction and inversion attacks. Existing defenses fail to address this practically: passive watermarking only offers post-hoc provenance, while active defenses impose prohibitive latency or require persistent access to sensitive training data. To bridge this gap, we propose \textit{LymphNode}, a novel post-hoc defense framework that acts as an intrinsic ``immune system" within the model. \textit{LymphNode} enforces a strict ``default-deny'' policy: it actively neutralizes model utility for unauthorized queries via \textbf{Generalized Sparse Universal Adversarial Perturbations (GSUAP)} injected into the feature space, effectively blocking gradient estimation and data inference. Utility is selectively restored only for authorized inputs carrying a stealthy feature-domain credential. Our framework is highly practical: it is \textbf{data-efficient}, establishing robust protection with fewer than 100 samples ($<1\%$ of training data), and \textbf{cross-dataset adaptable}, enabling protection using public surrogate datasets. \textit{LymphNode} thus provides a lightweight, immediately deployable defense for high-stakes scenarios where original training data is restricted or unavailable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 深度神经网络（DNN）作为高价值知识产权，在部署到边缘环境时面临无限制的预言机访问风险，容易遭受模型提取和逆向攻击。现有防御手段存在实际缺陷：被动水印仅提供事后溯源，主动防御则引入过高延迟或需要持续访问敏感训练数据。为了解决这一差距，本文提出了一种新型事后防御框架 LymphNode，它作为模型内部的固有“免疫系统”运行。LymphNode 执行严格的“默认拒绝”策略：通过向特征空间注入广义稀疏通用对抗扰动（GSUAP），主动抵消未授权查询的模型效用，有效阻断梯度估计和数据推理。仅对携带隐秘特征域凭证的授权输入选择性恢复效用。该框架具有高度实用性：数据高效，仅需少于 100 个样本（训练数据 <1%）即可建立稳健保护；跨数据集自适应，可使用公共替代数据集实现保护。LymphNode 为训练数据受限或不可用的高风险场景提供了一种轻量级、可立即部署的防御方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种即插即用的模型访问控制方法，解决了 DNN 边缘部署中未授权访问的实际威胁，对保护模型知识产权具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于需要将 DNN 部署到不可信边缘环境的高价值模型保护场景，如金融、医疗、自动驾驶等领域的模型 IP 保护。

items.title: From Backup Restoration to Minimum Viable Factory Recovery: A Systematization of Ransomware Recovery in Manufacturing Systems
items.summary: Ransomware recovery in critical manufacturing infrastructure is not only a backup-restoration problem. Production capability depends on coupled information-technology, operational-technology, physical-process, quality, logistics, identity, and supplier systems. After ransomware, a plant may rebuild servers yet remain unable to schedule work, authenticate operators, trust engineering workstations, release product, reconnect OT assets, or coordinate suppliers. This paper reframes manufacturing ransomware recovery as a critical-infrastructure continuity and interdependency problem. We conduct a PRISMA-guided multivocal review of academic literature, standards and government guidance, threat frameworks, public incident material, and verified full-text/source-page evidence anchors. The review identifies nine evidence-backed recovery failure modes: dependency blindness, untrusted restore point and backup over-trust, identity trust collapse, lack of proof-of-recovery, unsafe OT reconnection, segmentation assumption failure, capability mismatch, unmanaged degraded operation, and supplier dependency failure. We then introduce Minimum Viable Factory Recovery (MVF Recovery): the smallest safe, trusted, and operationally meaningful production capability that can be resumed under current dependency, evidence, identity, data, network, OT, and supplier constraints. MVF Recovery is an analytical objective rather than a claim of full recovery, implementation, or safety certification. The paper derives a recovery lifecycle and benchmarking directions as secondary outputs. The contribution is an evidence-calibrated foundation for capability-centric ransomware recovery in critical manufacturing infrastructure.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统化地研究了关键制造基础设施中的勒索软件恢复问题，指出恢复不仅仅是备份还原，还涉及信息技术、操作技术、物理过程、质量、物流、身份和供应商系统的耦合。通过PRISMA指导的多声部文献综述，识别出九种恢复失败模式：依赖盲目性、不可信的恢复点和备份过度信任、身份信任崩溃、缺乏恢复证明、不安全的OT重连、分段假设失败、能力不匹配、未管理的降级操作和供应商依赖失败。论文提出了“最小可行工厂恢复”（MVF Recovery）概念，即在当前依赖、证据、身份、数据、网络、OT和供应商约束下，可恢复的最小安全、可信且运营有意义的生产能力。该概念是分析目标而非全面恢复、实施或安全认证的主张。论文还推导了恢复生命周期和基准化方向作为辅助输出。贡献在于为关键制造基础设施中基于能力的勒索软件恢复提供了基于证据的基础。

items.title: PCDM: A Diffusion-Based Data Poisoning Attack Against Federated Learning Systems
items.summary: Federated learning (FL) is vulnerable to data poisoning attacks due to its distributed nature. Although recent GAN-based data poisoning methods have indicated the potential of using generative AI to generate seemingly legitimate poisoned data, the inherent consistency of GAN outputs can still reveal a sign of data poisoning. In this paper, we propose a diffusion-based data poisoning framework against FL systems, which leverages a Poisoning-Oriented Conditional Diffusion Model (PCDM) to enable fine-grained control over the local generation of poisoned data while ensuring both attack effectiveness and stealthiness. Our PCDM incorporates an adjustable poisoning vector within the global context to precisely control the generation of poisoned data, with theoretical guarantees on attack performance. Furthermore, it employs a novel jumping diffusion strategy for lightweight and efficient poisoned data generation. We conduct the most systematic and broad experimental evaluation for FL poisoning attacks against various defenses, including advanced Byzantine robust aggregation mechanisms, on four open datasets: MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and a real-world wireless-specific dataset VRAI. Our results demonstrate that PCDM is less likely to exhibit statistical anomalies compared with the state-of-the-art methods while more effectively degrading global FL performance, which poses a significant risk to data security in FL.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）因其分布式训练特性，易受数据投毒攻击。现有基于GAN的投毒方法虽能生成看似合法的毒化数据，但GAN输出的固有一致性仍会暴露统计异常。本文提出一种基于扩散模型的投毒框架PCDM（Poisoning-Oriented Conditional Diffusion Model），利用条件扩散模型对毒化数据生成进行细粒度控制，同时保证攻击的有效性和隐蔽性。PCDM在全局上下文中引入可调节的投毒向量，精确控制毒化数据的生成，并具有理论上的攻击性能保证。此外，其采用跳跃扩散策略实现轻量级高效生成。作者在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和真实无线数据集VRAI上进行了最系统、最广泛的实验评估，对比了包括先进拜占庭鲁棒聚合机制在内的多种防御。结果表明，PCDM相比现有方法更难被统计异常检测发现，同时更有效地降低全局FL性能，对FL数据安全构成显著威胁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次将扩散模型用于联邦学习投毒攻击，相比GAN方法更隐蔽，且可绕过多种鲁棒聚合防御，威胁FL系统的数据完整性和模型可靠性。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用联邦学习的分布式训练场景，尤其是对数据隐私敏感的医疗、金融、IoT等应用，可能导致模型被暗中破坏。

监控模型更新中的统计异常，结合多种检测方法提高对隐蔽投毒的识别能力。

items.title: A Cross-Modal Prompt Injection Attack against Large Vision-Language Models with Image-Only Perturbation
items.summary: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for multimodal intelligence, but their growing deployment also expands the attack surface of prompt injection. Despite this growing concern, existing attacks still suffer from a critical limitation: the injected prompt for one modality only steers the model's interpretation of that singular input. Alternatively, these attacks remain multimodal but fail to achieve cross-modal prompt perturbation. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel cross-modal prompt injection attack CrossMPI, which can steer the model's interpretation of both textual and visual inputs via image-only prompt injection. Our design is underpinned by the following key breakthroughs. First, we turn the focus of the injected prompt perturbation optimization from the visual embedding space (typically with only $10^5$ parameters) to the model hidden state space (for multimodal information integration and with $10^7$ parameters). Then, two strategies are adopted to mitigate the optimization challenges posed by the larger parameter space. To constrain the optimized model parameter space, we introduce a layer selection strategy that identifies the layers most critical to multimodal integration. Interestingly, deviating from the past experience, our analysis reveals that the optimal layers for LVLM prompt perturbation reside in the middle of the model rather than the last. To constrain the image perturbation space, we propose a new distance-decremental perturbation budget assignment strategy that allocates budgets decrementally as the pixel distance to semantic-critical regions increases. Extensive experiments across multiple LVLMs and datasets show that our method significantly outperforms baseline approaches.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的新型跨模态提示注入攻击方法，称为CrossMPI。传统提示注入攻击通常局限于单一模态，无法实现跨模态的扰动。CrossMPI通过仅对图像进行微小扰动，就能同时影响模型对文本和视觉输入的解读，从而实现跨模态的提示注入。其核心创新在于将注入扰动的优化目标从视觉嵌入空间（通常仅10^5参数）转移到模型隐藏状态空间（用于多模态信息整合，包含10^7参数）。为应对更大参数空间带来的优化挑战，作者提出了两项策略：一是层选择策略，通过分析识别出对多模态集成最关键的层（意外发现最佳扰动层位于模型中部而非尾部），从而限制优化的模型参数空间；二是距离递减扰动预算分配策略，根据像素到语义关键区域的距离递减分配扰动预算，从而限制图像的扰动空间。在多个LVLM模型（如LLaVA、MiniGPT-4等）和数据集上的实验表明，CrossMPI显著优于基线方法，能够以较低的扰动强度实现较高的攻击成功率。该研究揭示了LVLM在跨模态安全方面的脆弱性，为未来多模态系统的防御设计提供了重要参考。适合安全研究员、AI模型开发者和红蓝队成员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次实现仅通过图像扰动就能同时影响LVLM的文本和视觉输出，揭示了多模态模型存在更严重的跨模态安全漏洞，对部署LVLM的应用（如多模态聊天机器人、图像分析系统）构成实际威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有使用大型视觉语言模型的应用场景，如自动图像描述、视觉问答、多模态内容审核等，攻击者可误导模型输出有害或错误信息。

items.title: Who Owns This Agent? Tracing AI Agents Back to Their Owners
items.summary: AI agents are increasingly deployed to act autonomously in the world, yet there is still no reliable way to trace a harmful agent back to the account that deployed it. This creates the same accountability gap across both ends of the intent spectrum: benign operators may deploy misconfigured or overbroad agents that cause harm unintentionally, while malicious operators may deliberately weaponize agents for scams, harassment, or cyber attacks. In many cases, these agents are powered by vendor-hosted models, a dependency that holds even for sophisticated adversaries such as state actors conducting cyber operations. In either case, affected parties can observe the behavior but cannot notify the responsible operator, stop the session, or identify the account for investigation. We formalize this gap as the problem of agent attribution: linking an observed agent interaction to the responsible account at the hosting vendor. To our knowledge, this is the first work to define the problem and present a practical solution. Our protocol is canary-based: an authorized party injects a canary into the agent's interaction stream, and the vendor searches a narrow window of session logs to recover the originating session and account. Simple canaries suffice in non-adversarial settings. For adversarial operators who filter or paraphrase incoming content, we develop robust canary constructions that cannot be suppressed without degrading the agent's own task performance, yielding a formal asymmetry in the defender's favor. We evaluate a variety of scenarios including real-world agents and show that our attribution method is reliable, robust, and scalable for vendor-side deployment.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文首次正式定义并解决AI智能体的归因问题：当观察到有害的智能体行为时，如何将该行为追溯到部署该智能体的账户。当前缺乏可靠的归因机制，导致善意操作者可能因配置错误或权限过宽造成意外损害，恶意操作者也可利用智能体进行诈骗、骚扰或网络攻击，而受影响方无法通知负责方、停止会话或识别账户。作者提出一种基于“金丝雀”（canary）的归因协议：授权方（如受害系统）在智能体的交互流中注入金丝雀信号，托管智能体的供应商（如模型提供商）在会话日志的短时间窗口内搜索该信号，从而定位原始会话和账户。对于非对抗性场景，简单的金丝雀（如定制令牌或时间戳）即足够；对于存在对抗性操作者（会过滤或改写输入内容）的场景，作者设计了鲁棒的金丝雀结构，这些结构无法在不降低智能体自身任务性能的情况下被压制，从而形成形式化的防御者优势。作者在多种现实场景下评估了该方案，包括真实世界的智能体，证明该方法可靠、鲁棒且可扩展，适合供应商侧部署。该研究的核心贡献在于：定义了AI智能体归因这一新问题，提出了实用的解决方案，并理论证明了鲁棒金丝雀在对抗性条件下的有效性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 弥补了AI智能体部署中的问责空白，为防御者提供了一种追溯恶意或失配智能体源头的手段，有助于增强AI生态的安全性和可溯源性。

items.title: Quantum Futures Interactive: A Live Demonstration of Post-Quantum Blockchain Security, Infrastructure Tradeoffs, and Sustainable Distributed Trust
items.summary: Advances in quantum computing introduce long-term security challenges for widely deployed public-key cryptographic systems used across blockchain platforms and decentralized applications. Although post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards are emerging, understanding quantum risk remains fragmented across research, engineering, governance, and investment communities. This demo presents Quantum Futures Interactive, a live interdisciplinary demonstration platform combining educational visualization, participatory interaction, and cryptographic artifact generation to illustrate the transition from classical to quantum-resilient blockchain systems. Participants engage in a structured interaction flow including quantum threat education, sentiment capture, technology prioritization, infrastructure tradeoff exploration, and generation of post-quantum cryptographic outputs. The system integrates distributed trust concepts, sustainability-aware infrastructure considerations, and responsible innovation within an interactive decision framework. The demonstration supports interdisciplinary dialogue on blockchain resilience while aligning with United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并演示了“Quantum Futures Interactive”平台，这是一个实时的跨学科演示系统，旨在直观展示区块链系统从经典密码学向抗量子密码学（PQC）过渡的过程。背景是量子计算的进步对当前广泛使用的公钥密码体系构成长期威胁，尤其是区块链和去中心化应用依赖这些密码算法。尽管后量子密码标准正在制定中，但研究、工程、治理和投资社区对量子风险的认知仍然分散。为解决这一问题，作者构建了一个集教育可视化、参与式互动和密码学工件生成于一体的平台。参与者的互动流程包括：量子威胁教育、情感捕捉、技术优先级排序、基础设施权衡探索，以及生成后量子密码输出。系统整合了分布式信任概念、可持续性感知的基础设施考量以及负责任创新，并置于互动决策框架中。该演示支持关于区块链韧性的跨学科对话，同时与联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）保持一致。论文的主要贡献在于提供了一个可操作、可交互的工具，以弥合不同领域对量子风险的认知差距，并促进对后量子区块链安全性及其基础设施权衡的共同理解。适合区块链开发者、安全研究员、政策制定者和对量子安全感兴趣的从业者阅读。

items.title: Beyond Content: A Comprehensive Speech Toxicity Dataset and Detection Framework Incorporating Paralinguistic Cues
items.summary: Toxic speech detection has become a crucial challenge in maintaining safe online communication environments. However, existing approaches to toxic speech detection often neglect the contribution of paralinguistic cues, such as emotion, intonation, and speech rate, which are key to detecting speech toxicity. Moreover, current toxic speech datasets are predominantly text-based, limiting the development of models that can capture paralinguistic cues.To address these challenges, we present ToxiAlert-Bench, a large-scale audio dataset comprising over 30,000 audio clips annotated with seven major toxic categories and twenty fine-grained toxic labels. Uniquely, our dataset annotates toxicity sources -- distinguishing between textual content and paralinguistic origins -- for comprehensive toxic speech analysis.Furthermore, we propose a dual-head neural network with a multi-stage training strategy tailored for toxic speech detection. This architecture features two task-specific classification headers: one for identifying the source of sensitivity (textual or paralinguistic), and the other for categorizing the specific toxic type. The training process involves independent head training followed by joint fine-tuning to reduce task interference. To mitigate data class imbalance, we incorporate class-balanced sampling and weighted loss functions.Our experimental results show that leveraging paralinguistic features significantly improves detection performance. Our method consistently outperforms existing baselines across multiple evaluation metrics, with a 21.1% relative improvement in Macro-F1 score and a 13.0% relative gain in accuracy over the strongest baseline, highlighting its enhanced effectiveness and practical applicability.

items.title: PersonaFingerprint: Measuring Persona Inference on Modern Websites with LLM-Driven Browsing
items.summary: Website Fingerprinting (WFP) has traditionally focused on inferring which website a user visits from encrypted traffic metadata such as packet sizes and timing. In this paper, we identify and quantify a new privacy risk in modern web settings: an adversary can infer a user's persona using only packet-length and inter-arrival-time sequences. To study this risk at scale, we build an LLM-driven multi-agent browsing framework that enforces controllable persona constraints while a computer-use agent interacts with real websites and collects corresponding encrypted traffic traces. We formalize persona fingerprinting under both closed-set and open-world settings and further evaluate whether persona information is already embedded in representations learned by existing WFP models and can be amplified at low cost. Across 10 modern websites and 15 personas (plus an open-world class), persona inference achieves about 84% accuracy on mixed-site traffic; moreover, a lightweight multi-task objective can boost persona accuracy to around 80% while retaining strong site classification performance (about 93% baseline). Our results show that, on modern websites, encrypted traffic metadata can leak not only which site a user visits, but also how they browse and who is browsing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并量化了一种新型的Web隐私风险：入侵者仅通过加密流量的数据包长度和到达间隔时间序列，即可推断用户的“角色”（persona）。传统网站指纹识别（WFP）聚焦于识别用户访问了哪个网站，而该研究进一步揭示，在现代Web设置中，用户的行为模式（如浏览方式、身份类型）同样能从加密流量元数据中泄露。为大规模研究这一风险，作者构建了一个基于LLM驱动的多智能体浏览框架，该框架在计算机使用智能体与真实网站交互时施加可控的角色约束，并收集对应的加密流量轨迹。论文在封闭集和开放集场景下正式定义了角色指纹识别，并评估了现有WFP模型所学表示中是否已嵌入角色信息以及能否低成本增强。在10个现代网站和15种角色（加上开放集类别）上，混合站点流量的角色推断准确率达到约84%；此外，一个轻量级的多任务目标可在保持强网站分类性能（约93%基线）的同时，将角色准确率提升至约80%。实验结果表明，现代网站上的加密流量元数据不仅能泄露用户访问了哪个网站，还能泄露用户如何浏览以及谁在浏览。该工作适合隐私研究人员、Web安全工程师以及WFP领域的研究者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了加密流量元数据的隐私泄漏远超预期：不仅可识别网站，还能推断用户角色（如身份、行为模式），对在线广告、用户画像及隐私攻击有重大影响，安全从业者需重新评估流量分析防御策略。

items.title: Privacy is Fungibility: Why Endogenous Tokens Are Not Money
items.summary: In this paper, we make a case that endogenous tokens such as cryptoassets are not money. First, we define and classify tokens found on public, permissionless ledgers, contrasting them with privately issued stablecoins and proposed CBDC designs. We then discuss the work of Kahn et al in Money is Privacy on cash versus simplified credit, and we extend their analysis to the situation found on most public, permissionless ledgers. Many public, permissionless ledgers utilize an account-based abstraction for balances, resulting in a default state that maps onto the most harmful models of agent interaction enumerated in Money is Privacy. The conclusion is threefold: that most blockchain economies lack a cash-like primitive; that stablecoins do not intrinsically fulfil this role; and that the reliance of a network on an endogenous token for security exposes holders even of a privacy-preserving asset to the same risk, if that asset relies on the same global ledger state as the endogenous token.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文论证了内源性代币（如加密货币）并非真正的货币。首先，作者对公共无许可账本上的代币进行了分类和定义，将其与私人发行的稳定币和央行数字货币（CBDC）设计进行对比。然后，他们引用了Kahn等人在《Money is Privacy》中关于现金与简化信用的分析，并将其扩展到大多数公共无许可账本的情境中。许多公共无许可账本采用基于账户的余额抽象，导致默认状态映射到《Money is Privacy》中列举的最有害的代理交互模型。结论有三：第一，大多数区块链经济缺乏类似现金的原语；第二，稳定币本质上并不能充当这一角色；第三，网络依赖内源性代币进行安全性保障，使得即使是隐私保护型资产的持有者也面临同样的风险，因为该资产依赖于与内源性代币相同的全局账本状态。本文的核心贡献在于揭示了隐私与可替代性的等同关系，并指出当前区块链架构在隐私和货币属性上的根本缺陷。适合对加密货币经济学、隐私设计以及区块链安全感兴趣的读者。

items.title: A Multi-Layer Cloud-IDS Pipeline with LLM and Adaptive Q-Learning Calibration
items.summary: Security in cloud computing has become a major concern due to several factors such as layered cloud architectures, dynamic environments, and exposure to unseen or zero-day attacks. Moreover, intrusion detection systems (IDS) typically operate at specific layers and rely heavily on machine learning models, which often perform well in experimental settings but fail to sustain performance in real cloud deployments. In this work, we implement a confidence-aware multilevel intrusion detection system using reinforcement learning tailored for cloud environments. The system secures three distinct layers: network, host, and hypervisor. Machine learning models at each layer detect known attack patterns, while prediction confidence distinguishes reliable decisions from uncertain outcomes. Within the multi-gate flow, low-confidence events pass through a learned-threshold confidence gate (Gate-1), followed by a Chroma memory-matching gate (Gate-2), with unresolved events escalated to a large language model (LLM) for semantic analysis and explanation. Final attack promotion at Gate-3 uses calibrated LLM confidence or weighted-fusion fallback, while uncertain events are retained in a review bucket to avoid forced classification. Generated explanations and confirmed knowledge are stored in ChromaDB to support future analysis and retraining. The approach is first evaluated using static thresholds, establishing a baseline for comparison. Results show that the proposed system learns adaptive thresholds and reduces LLM escalation by 58.78%, lowering cost while maintaining strong performance (88.68% accuracy, 85.29% precision, 84.72% recall, 85.00% F1). The network and hypervisor layers achieve 98.02% and 97.08% accuracy, demonstrating a balanced and efficient detection system.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种面向云环境的、基于置信度感知的多层入侵检测系统（ML-IDS），系统覆盖网络层、主机层和虚拟机监控器层三个层面。每层的机器学习模型负责检测已知攻击模式，同时通过预测置信度区分可靠决策与不确定结果。系统采用多级门控流程：低置信度事件先经过基于学习阈值的置信度门（Gate-1），再进入基于Chroma数据库的记忆匹配门（Gate-2），仍未解决的事件则提交给大语言模型（LLM）进行语义分析和解释。最终在Gate-3通过校准后的LLM置信度或加权融合做出攻击判定，而仍不确定的事件被保留在审查桶中以避免强制分类。生成的解释和确认的知识存入ChromaDB以支持后续分析和重训练。实验先使用静态阈值建立基线，对比表明所提系统能学习自适应阈值，LLM调用减少了58.78%，同时保持强性能（准确率88.68%、精确率85.29%、召回率84.72%、F1分数85.00%），其中网络层和虚拟机监控器层准确率分别达98.02%和97.08%，证明该系统均衡且高效。

items.title: FedEDAuth -- Federated Embedding Distribution Authentication for Counterfeit IC Detection
items.summary: The widespread of counterfeit integrated circuits (ICs) poses severe risks to the security, reliability, and trustworthiness of modern electronic systems. Federated learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving paradigm for collaborative counterfeit detection across the semiconductor supply chain, but its vulnerability to byzantine data poisoning attacks limits practical deployment. This paper presents Federated Embedding Distribution Authentication (FedEDAuth), a lightweight, embedding level client authentication framework that detects and filters malicious participants before model aggregation. FedEDAuth leverages reference embedding distributions derived from a golden dataset and evaluates clients using outlier analysis, mean shift measurements, and micro-cluster behavior without requiring access to raw data or gradients. Integrated into standard FL pipelines, FedEDAuth consistently identifies all poisoned clients in experimental settings with 50 distributed participants under the byzantine data poisoning attack, achieving a 100% malicious client detection rate. After filtering, the federated model achieved a high counterfeit IC classification performance of 94.17% accuracy. These results not only validate FedEDAuth's effectiveness but also underscore the broader potential of secure, trustworthy FL frameworks as a critical advancement for next generation hardware security solutions, enabling robust, collaborative intelligence across the semiconductor supply chain.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文聚焦于联邦学习(FL)在半导体供应链中用于协同检测伪造集成电路(IC)时面临的拜占庭数据投毒攻击问题。传统联邦学习依赖客户端数据更新，但恶意参与者提交的虚假更新会破坏全局模型的准确性和可靠性。作者提出了一种轻量级的客户端身份验证框架FedEDAuth（联邦嵌入分布认证），其核心思想是在模型聚合之前，利用从黄金数据集（已知真品）中提取的参考嵌入分布，对每个客户端的嵌入分布进行异常检测。具体方法包括：基于离群点分析、均值偏移测量和微簇行为评估，无需访问原始数据或梯度。框架无缝集成到标准FL流程中。实验在50个分布式参与者且存在拜占庭攻击的场景下，实现了100%的恶意客户端检测率，过滤后联邦模型对伪造IC的分类准确率达到94.17%。这项工作不仅验证了FedEDAuth的有效性，更展示了安全可信联邦学习作为下一代硬件安全解决方案的潜力，使半导体供应链能够进行鲁棒的协作智能。适合硬件安全研究人员、联邦学习实践者以及供应链安全从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究针对半导体供应链中伪造IC检测的隐私与安全痛点，提出首个嵌入级别的联邦学习防御框架，在保持数据隐私的同时有效抵御投毒攻击，对提升硬件供应链的可信度有重要价值。

items.title: Security Analysis of a Communication Protocol: MQTT
items.summary: This paper analyzes the security of the Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocol in the context of the Internet of Things (IoT). The main objective consists of identifying vulnerabilities and proposing security improvements. Adopting a hybrid methodology, a theoretical review was combined with an experimental demonstration in a simulated Smart Home environment. Eavesdropping, Tampering, Denial of Service (DoS), and Brute Force attacks were executed and analyzed. The results evidenced critical risks due to the absence of robust encryption and authentication. Finally, mitigation strategies and best practices are proposed to strengthen MQTT implementations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文对物联网（IoT）环境中广泛使用的消息队列遥测传输（MQTT）协议进行了全面的安全性分析。研究采用混合方法论，首先通过理论回顾梳理MQTT协议的设计缺陷与已知攻击面，随后在模拟智能家居环境中搭建实验平台，实际执行了四种典型攻击：窃听（Eavesdropping）、篡改（Tampering）、拒绝服务（DoS）和暴力破解（Brute Force）。实验结果表明，由于MQTT协议默认缺乏强制性的传输层加密（如TLS）和有效的身份认证机制，攻击者可以轻松拦截明文通信、伪造消息、耗尽系统资源或通过弱口令入侵代理服务器。例如，在无TLS模式下，攻击者使用Wireshark即可捕获所有MQTT数据包；通过发送大量连接请求可以压垮Broker；对默认端口1883的暴力破解成功率极高。论文据此提出了一系列缓解措施和最佳实践，包括强制启用TLS加密、实施客户端证书认证、部署防火墙规则限制端口暴露、采用速率限制机制防止DoS、以及使用安全凭据管理。研究强调了即使在受限的IoT设备上，也需优先考虑安全配置而非仅追求性能。该工作适合IoT安全研究人员、协议开发者及智能家居系统管理员阅读，为加固MQTT部署提供了实证依据和明确指导。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: MQTT是物联网通信的事实标准协议，其安全配置不当可导致全网瘫痪、数据泄露或设备被控。本研究的攻击实证和缓解建议直接适用于智能家居、工业IoT、车联网等场景，对蓝队评估自身MQTT基础设施风险具有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响广泛部署MQTT的IoT环境（智能家居、工业传感器、医疗设备等）；攻击可导致敏感数据泄露、服务中断、设备假冒。

items.title: Beyond Controlled Noise: Achieving Symmetric FHE through Dynamic Position Shifting
items.summary: Traditional Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) schemes often suffer from prohibitive computational overhead and complex noise management. In this paper, we propose a novel symmetric FHE through a mechanism of plaintext fragmentation and dynamic interposition. Our approach is built upon a modular encryption foundation, c = mk + rp, which is naturally additive but typically limited by exponential noise growth during multiplication. To resolve this, we introduce an interposition framework where the plaintext is partitioned into multiple fragments across distinct logical positions. We introduce a dual-regulator system to govern the multiplication process; exponent regulators (t_i) redirect the product of fragments to a new target position, preventing the accumulation of secret key exponents, while coefficient regulators (d_i) normalize the resulting scalars. Security is established through a binding mechanism where exponents and coefficients are mutually dependent, shielding the secret key k from algebraic manipulation and substitution attacks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对传统全同态加密（FHE）方案计算开销大、噪声管理复杂的问题，提出了一种新的对称全同态加密方案，核心机制是明文分片（plaintext fragmentation）与动态位置移动（dynamic position shifting）。方案基于模块化加密基础 c = mk + rp，该结构自然支持加法同态，但乘法时存在指数级噪声增长。为解决此问题，作者引入了交织框架（interposition framework），将明文划分为多个片段并置于不同的逻辑位置。乘法过程由双调节器系统（dual-regulator system）控制：指数调节器（t_i）将片段乘积重定向到新的目标位置，防止秘密密钥指数累积；系数调节器（d_i）对结果标量进行归一化。安全性通过绑定机制（binding mechanism）实现，使得指数与系数相互依赖，从而防止对秘密密钥 k 的代数操作和替换攻击。实验部分（摘要未详述）可能验证了方案的正确性和效率。本文适合密码学研究者、全同态加密领域从业者以及对安全计算感兴趣的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提出了一种新颖的对称FHE架构，通过动态位置移动从根本上抑制噪声增长，有望提升同态加密的实用性。

items.title: The Privacy Subsidy: Kyle's $λ$ under Noise-Perturbed Order-Flow Observation
items.summary: Privacy-preserving cryptocurrency exchanges (shielded AMMs, batched swap auctions, sealed-bid order-flow auctions) alter what the pricing mechanism observes about order flow. We derive the unique linear Kyle equilibrium when a committed Bayesian market maker observes order flow perturbed by independent Gaussian privacy noise. The price-impact coefficient and informed-trader strategy both rescale by a single factor in the privacy parameter, and their product is invariant. A welfare decomposition then identifies a closed-form per-period transfer from the protocol's LP pool to traders -- the "privacy subsidy", the break-even fee any privacy-aggregated exchange must charge. The result is the single-period closed-form privacy-noise analog of Loss-Versus-Rebalancing (Milionis et al. 2022). The primary application is shielded AMMs with explicit additive-noise injection (e.g., differential privacy); related designs (batched swaps, sealed-bid auctions, oracle-pegged crossings) require separate frameworks that we leave to future work.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究隐私保护加密货币交易所（如屏蔽AMM、批处理交换拍卖、密封订单流拍卖）中，价格机制观察到的订单流被噪声扰动后的均衡特性。作者在线性Kyle模型框架下，推导了当做市商观察到经独立高斯隐私噪声扰动的订单流时的唯一线性均衡。结果表明，价格影响系数和知情交易者策略均按隐私参数的单因子重新缩放，且其乘积保持不变。通过福利分解，作者识别出从协议LP池到交易者的每期封闭形式转移——即“隐私补贴”，这是任何隐私聚合交易所必须收取的盈亏平衡费用。该结果是单期封闭形式隐私噪声下的损失与再平衡（Loss-Versus-Rebalancing, Milionis et al. 2022）的类比。主要应用场景是显式加噪注入（如差分隐私）的屏蔽AMM；其他相关设计（批处理交换、密封拍卖、预言机锚定交叉）需要单独框架，留待未来工作。论文为隐私聚合交易所的经济设计提供了理论基础，适合密码学与金融交叉领域的研究者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次从理论均衡角度量化了隐私保护交易对定价机制的影响，给出了隐私补贴的封闭形式，为设计防操纵且经济可持续的隐私交易协议提供了依据。

items.title: Rethinking the Security of DP-SGD: A Corrected Analysis of Differentially Private Machine Learning
items.summary: Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) is widely used to protect training data in machine learning. Its privacy guarantee is commonly analyzed through a security game in which an adversary infers whether a target record is included in the training dataset from the mechanism output. The resulting privacy leakage is characterized by a privacy curve, which reports the false negative rate as a function of the false positive rate. We identify a mismatch between this formal analysis and common DP-SGD implementations. Existing analyses often model DP-SGD and its variants as the Subsampled Gaussian Mechanism (SGM), where Gaussian noise is added to the sum of clipped gradients computed from a Poisson-sampled batch. In practice, however, many implementations apply an additional normalization step: the noisy gradient sum is divided either by the expected batch size or by the sampled batch size. These mechanisms are therefore better formalized as the Expected-Averaged SGM (EASGM) or the Batch-Averaged SGM (ASGM), respectively. We re-analyze the privacy guarantees of DP-SGD under the EASGM and ASGM formulations. Our theoretical results show that these guarantees can be weaker than the standard SGM-based guarantee, implying that the true privacy leakage may exceed the reported guarantee in some regimes. We further audit four state-of-the-art DP-SGD implementations, including Meta's Opacus library, and observe empirical leakage beyond the SGM-based guarantees. Finally, we audit Opacus versions v0.9.0 to v1.5.4 and derive a corrected privacy guarantee for the latest implementation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）是保护机器学习训练数据隐私的常用方法，其隐私保证通常通过安全游戏进行分析：攻击者根据机制输出推断目标记录是否在训练数据中，隐私损失由隐私曲线（以假阳性率为函数的假阴性率）刻画。然而，现有分析往往将DP-SGD及其变体建模为子采样高斯机制（SGM），即对从泊松采样批次计算的裁剪梯度之和添加高斯噪声。但在实际实现中，许多框架额外增加了归一化步骤：将带噪梯度之和除以期望批次大小或实际采样批次大小。这两种机制分别对应期望平均SGM（EASGM）和批次平均SGM（ASGM）。本文重新分析了DP-SGD在EASGM和ASGM形式下的隐私保证，理论结果表明这些保证可能弱于标准SGM的保证，意味着在某些情况下真实隐私泄漏可能超过报告的保证。进一步地，作者审计了四种先进的DP-SGD实现（包括Meta的Opacus库），观察到超过SGM保证的实证泄漏。最后，审计了Opacus v0.9.0至v1.5.4版本，并为最新实现推导了修正后的隐私保证。该工作揭示了DP-SGD实际部署中的隐私风险，提醒从业者注意实现细节对隐私保护强度的显著影响。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示常用DP-SGD实现可能高估隐私保护，导致数据泄漏风险被低估。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进：建议使用DP-SGD的团队阅读本文并检查自己的实现是否采用了正确的隐私分析。

items.title: Propagating Unsafe Actions in LLM Controlled Multi-Robot Collaboration via Single Robot Compromise
items.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as general planners in embodied intelligence, enabling high level coordination and low level task planning for both single robot and multi-robot collaboration. This increasing reliance on embodied LLM planners also raises critical security concerns, since misaligned or manipulated instructions can be translated into physical actions. Prior work has studied such threats in single robot settings, while security risks in LLM controlled multi-robot collaboration, especially those propagated through inter robot communication, remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we propose a novel attack paradigm for multi-robot system in which the adversary interacts with only a single entry robot. The compromised robot then propagates malicious intent through peer communication, leading to coordinated unsafe actions across the system. Our evaluation, covering high risk dimensions of dereliction of duty, privacy compromise, and public safety hazards, reveals a persistent safety alignment gap in multi-robot planners. We quantify this process with three metrics, obedience, infectiousness, and stealthiness. Experiments demonstrate both persistent attacker control and rapid propagation: obedience reaches 1.00 in the strongest cases, and infectiousness rises to 0.90. Notably, the attack is highly efficient, requiring as few as 3.0 rounds to compromise all the robots while maintaining a stealthiness score of 0.81. Such risks are amplified when robots must resolve trade offs in critical situations, such as emergencies or conflicts of rights, because the coordination mechanism can unintentionally allow adversarial instructions to override safety requirements. The code is available at https://github.com/TheFatInsect/InfectBot.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在多机器人协作系统中作为规划器时面临的安全威胁。现有工作主要关注单机器人场景下的指令操控风险，而多机器人系统中通过机器人间通信传播恶意行为的问题尚未被充分探索。作者提出了一种新型攻击范式：攻击者仅需攻破一个入口机器人，被攻破的机器人则通过协作通信机制将恶意指令传播给其他机器人，导致整个系统执行不安全的协调动作。研究覆盖了三个高风险维度：失职（机器人违反任务职责）、隐私泄露（如错误地共享敏感信息）和公共安全危害（如在紧急情况下做出危险决策）。为了量化攻击效果，作者定义了三个指标：服从性（机器人执行恶意指令的程度）、传染性（恶意行为传播的速度和范围）和隐蔽性（攻击不被检测到的程度）。实验表明，攻击在最强场景下服从性可达1.00，传染性可达0.90，且仅需平均3轮通信即可完全控制所有机器人，同时保持0.81的隐蔽性。论文提供了开源代码。该工作揭示了LLM控制的多机器人系统在安全对齐方面的漏洞，特别是在需要权衡冲突指令的紧急场景中，协调机制可能意外允许恶意指令覆盖安全要求。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着LLM被用于多机器人协作规划，一次单点攻破即可通过机器人间通信引发连锁不安全行为，对工业、急救、军事等关键场景构成现实威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 威胁可迁移至任何由LLM规划的多机器人系统，尤其适用于需要紧急决策或存在权利冲突的场景（如灾后救援、自动驾驶车队）。

items.title: Compositional Jailbreaking: An Empirical Analysis of Mutator Chain Interactions in Aligned LLMs
items.summary: Jailbreaking attacks on large language models pose a significant threat to AI safety by enabling the generation of harmful or restricted content. While prior work has explored both handcrafted and automated jailbreak strategies, the potential for compositional interaction between simple attacks remains underexplored. This paper presents a systematic study of mutator chaining, in which weak jailbreak transformations are applied sequentially to characterize how they interact: whether they reinforce one another, interfere destructively, or produce no meaningful change. We implement twelve baseline mutators and evaluate all ordered pairs on a benchmark of harmful prompts against three popular LLM models. Our framework introduces metrics for completeness and validity that capture both transformation persistence and attack effectiveness. Results reveal that the interaction landscape is highly non-uniform, while most combinations fail to outperform individual mutators, exhibiting destructive interference or structural incompatibility, a small fraction produce synergistic effects that improve attack success rates. Equally important, the prevalent failure modes reveal structural properties of safety alignment that are not apparent from single-strategy evaluations. These findings highlight the nuanced dynamics of adversarial prompt composition and offer new insights for building more robust safety defenses.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统性地研究了大型语言模型（LLM）安全对齐中的组合型越狱攻击。现有工作主要关注手工或自动化的单一越狱策略，但对于简单攻击之间的组合交互作用关注不足。作者提出了一种突变器链式组合框架，将多个弱越狱变换按顺序应用于提示词，以分析它们之间的相互作用类型：相互增强、相互干扰或无明显变化。他们实现了12种基线突变器，并在三个流行LLM模型上对有害提示基准测试了所有有序对组合。框架引入了完整性和有效性指标，分别衡量变换的持久性和攻击的成功率。实验结果表明，交互图景高度非均匀：大多数组合未能超越单一突变器的效果，表现出破坏性干扰或结构不兼容；但少数组合产生了协同效应，提升了攻击成功率。更重要的是，常见的失败模式揭示了安全对齐的结构特性，而这些特性在单一策略评估中无法体现。该研究突出了对抗性提示组合的细微动力学，为构建更鲁棒的安全防御提供了新见解。适合AI安全研究人员、LLM安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了简单越狱攻击组合后可能产生协同或干扰的复杂行为，对理解LLM安全对齐的脆弱性和设计更具鲁棒的防御机制有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响LLM安全对齐研究，可能推动防御策略向考虑组合攻击的方向演进。

items.title: Detecting Privilege Escalation in Polyglot Microservices via Agentic Program Analysis
items.summary: Microservices are widely adopted in modern cloud systems due to their scalability and fault tolerance. However, microservice architectures introduce significant complexity in privilege and permission control, creating risks of privilege escalation where attackers can gain unauthorized access to resources or operations. Detecting such vulnerabilities is challenging due to complex cross-service interactions, polyglot codebases, and diverse privileged operations and permission checks. We present Neo, an agentic program analysis framework that combines large language models (LLMs) with classic program analysis to address these challenges. Neo leverages an LLM-based agent that dynamically generates analysis plans, adapts code search strategies, and validates semantics. We develop code search primitives that enable Neo to perform scalable and flexible code exploration across services and languages. We evaluated Neo on 25 open-source microservice applications spanning 7 programming languages and 6.2 million lines of code. Neo uncovered 24 zero-day privilege escalation vulnerabilities and achieved 81.0% precision and 85.0% recall on a ground-truth dataset. Compared to existing program analysis and agentic solutions, Neo demonstrated significant improvements in both detection accuracy and scalability. We further showcased Neo's extensibility by applying it to other application domains and vulnerability types, uncovering 18 additional zero-day vulnerabilities.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为Neo的智能程序分析框架，旨在检测多语言微服务架构中的权限提升漏洞。现代云系统广泛采用微服务架构，因其可扩展性和容错性，但这也引入了复杂的权限控制问题，导致攻击者可能通过跨服务交互获得未授权访问。现有检测方法面临三大挑战：跨服务交互复杂、多语言代码库（Polyglot）以及多样化的特权操作和权限检查。Neo结合大型语言模型（LLM）与传统程序分析技术，利用基于LLM的智能体动态生成分析计划、自适应调整代码搜索策略并验证语义正确性。框架设计了代码搜索原语，支持跨服务和跨语言的可扩展且灵活的代码探索。研究团队在25个开源微服务应用上评估了Neo，这些应用涵盖7种编程语言，总代码量达620万行。Neo发现了24个零日权限提升漏洞，在真实数据集上达到了81.0%的精确率和85.0%的召回率。与现有程序分析和智能体解决方案相比，Neo在检测准确性和可扩展性上均有显著提升。此外，Neo被证明可扩展到其他应用领域和漏洞类型，额外发现了18个零日漏洞。该研究为微服务安全检测提供了创新方法论，适合安全研究员、微服务架构师和自动化漏洞检测工具开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 微服务架构中权限提升漏洞难以检测，Neo结合LLM与程序分析，在真实应用中高效发现零日漏洞，显著优于现有方案，对云安全防御具有重要价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至其他多语言微服务系统及不同漏洞类型（如任意18个额外零日漏洞），提升自动化漏洞检测能力。

items.title: uGen: An Agentic Framework for Generating Microarchitectural Attack PoCs
items.summary: Microarchitectural attacks continue to evolve, uncovering new exploitation vectors in modern processors. From a defensive perspective, assessing a system's susceptibility to such attacks remains challenging. Developing functional attack implementations is labor-intensive, requires deep microarchitectural expertise, and is highly sensitive to execution environments. Consequently, existing attacks often lack portability, limiting systematic and scalable vulnerability assessment. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) suggest a potential avenue for lowering these barriers. However, it remains unclear whether LLMs can reliably generate functionally correct microarchitectural attack code suitable for rigorous vulnerability testing. In this work, we present uGen, the first LLM-driven framework for automated microarchitectural attack code generation. A key challenge we address is identifying attack-specific knowledge gaps in LLMs. Through a systematic study of state-of-the-art models (GPT, Claude, and Qwen3), we find that LLMs frequently misgenerate or misplace critical attack primitives. Guided by this analysis, uGen employs a retrieval-augmented, multi-agent design that injects missing domain knowledge to synthesize functionally correct microarchitectural attack PoCs tailored to defender requirements. We evaluate uGen on cache-based and speculative-execution attacks across diverse set of microarchitectures, vulnerable functions, and LLM platforms. In the deployment stage, uGen achieves up to 100% success rate for Spectre-v1 (Claude Sonnet-4) and 80% for Prime+Probe (Qwen3-Coder). Finally, we demonstrate that uGen can generate a successful PoC code with a cost of $1.25 in under four minutes.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 微架构攻击（如缓存攻击、推测执行攻击）是现代处理器面临的重要安全威胁，但防御者评估系统对该类攻击的脆弱性仍存在挑战。传统上，开发可用的攻击实现需要深厚的微架构专业知识，且攻击代码对环境高度敏感，导致现有攻击缺乏可移植性，阻碍了系统化的漏洞评估。大型语言模型（LLM）的进步为降低这些门槛提供了可能，但 LLM 能否可靠地生成功能正确的微架构攻击代码尚无定论。本文提出 uGen，首个基于 LLM 驱动的自动化微架构攻击 PoC 生成框架。作者首先系统研究了 GPT、Claude 和 Qwen3 等模型在攻击代码生成中的知识缺陷，发现模型常错误生成或放置关键攻击原语。基于此，uGen 采用检索增强的多智能体设计，注入缺失的领域知识，以合成符合防御者需求的功能正确的攻击 PoC。文中针对缓存攻击（Prime+Probe）和推测执行攻击（Spectre-v1）在多种微架构、易感函数和 LLM 平台上进行了评估。在部署阶段，uGen 在 Spectre-v1 上（Claude Sonnet-4）达到 100% 的成功率，在 Prime+Probe 上（Qwen3-Coder）达到 80%。此外，生成一个成功 PoC 的平均成本仅为 1.25 美元，耗时不到 4 分钟。该工作为防御者提供了一种低成本、可扩展的自动化漏洞评估手段，有助于提前发现处理器中的微架构侧信道风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出自动化生成微架构攻击 PoC 的框架，大幅降低防御者评估处理器侧信道脆弱性的门槛，有望推动系统化安全测试自动化。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于 CPU 漏洞评估、云环境隔离性测试、硬件安全审计等场景，可迁移至其他侧信道攻击类型。

items.title: Topical Shifts in the Dark Web: A Longitudinal Analysis of Content from the Cybercrime Ecosystem
items.summary: The dark web hosts a dynamic ecosystem of cybercrime forums and marketplaces that adapt to law enforcement pressure, technological change, and economic incentives. Prior research has extracted cyber threat intelligence from these platforms using static snapshots, with limited attention to how discussions evolve over time. In this study, we conduct a longitudinal analysis of 25,065 websites in the dark web using 11,403,638 HTML snapshots (approximately 1245.38 GB) collected over six years. We develop a longitudinal topic-modeling framework combining domain-specific embeddings, density-based clustering and temporal aggregation to measure topic prevalence and lifecycle at the website level. Our analysis identifies 55 thematic clusters. We find that approximately 75% of total discussion volume is concentrated in a small set of persistent core topics, while short-lived themes account for approximately 3% of activity. The median topic lifespan is 75 months, indicating gradual thematic evolution rather than abrupt replacement.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究对暗网中网络犯罪论坛和市场的讨论内容进行了纵向分析。研究团队收集了过去六年中25065个暗网站点的11403638个HTML快照（约1245.38 GB数据），开发了一个纵向主题建模框架，结合域特定嵌入、密度聚类和时间聚合方法，在网站层面测量主题流行度和生命周期。分析识别出55个主题簇，发现大约75%的讨论量集中在少数持久的核心主题上，而短期主题约占活动量的3%。主题中位寿命为75个月，表明主题演化是渐进的而非突然更替。该研究揭示了暗网网络犯罪生态系统如何适应执法压力、技术变化和经济激励，为理解暗网内容演变提供了大规模实证。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提供了对暗网主题演变的量化理解，有助于安全分析师追踪犯罪讨论趋势，改进威胁情报收集策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 提升对暗网犯罪生态长期动态的认知，可为预测新兴威胁和优化监控资源分配提供参考。

items.why_it_matters: 该研究提供了对暗网主题演变的量化理解，有助于安全分析师追踪犯罪讨论趋势，改进威胁情报收集策略。

items.title: Hidden in Memory: Sleeper Memory Poisoning in LLM Agents
items.summary: Large language models are increasingly augmented with persistent memory, allowing assistants to store user-specific information across sessions for personalization and continuity. This statefulness introduces a new security risk: adversarial content can corrupt what an assistant remembers and thereby influence future interactions. We propose and study sleeper memory poisoning, a delayed attack in which an adversary manipulates external context, such as a document, webpage, or repository, to cause the assistant to store a fabricated memory about the user. Unlike conventional prompt injection, the attack can remain dormant and re-emerge across multiple later conversations. We evaluate the full attack pipeline: whether poisoned memories are written, later retrieved, and ultimately used to steer the following conversations. Across stateful LLM assistants, poisoned memories were added up to 99.8% on GPT-5.5 and 95% on Kimi-K2.6. Crucially, among successful retrievals, poisoned memories cause attacker-intended agentic actions in 60-89% of evaluations across models. These results show that persistent memory can act as a long-term attack surface across multiple future conversations.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出并研究了面向 LLM 智能体的“沉睡记忆投毒”攻击。随着 LLM 越来越多地配备持久记忆模块（如用户长期会话记忆），智能体可以在多次对话之间存储和检索用户特定信息以实现个性化与连续性。然而，这种有状态特性引入了一个新的安全风险：攻击者可以通过操控外部输入（如文档、网页或代码仓库）来诱导智能体存储关于用户的虚假记忆。与传统的即时提示注入不同，该攻击可以潜伏在记忆存储中，在后续多个对话中被重新激活并影响智能体的行为。作者构建了完整的攻击流程：投毒阶段（操控上下文使得智能体写入虚假记忆）、潜伏阶段（记忆存储）、检索阶段（后续对话中记忆被召回）以及利用阶段（记忆影响智能体决策）。实验基于 GPT-5.5 和 Kimi-K2.6 等有状态的 LLM 助手，结果显示投毒记忆写入成功率高达 99.8%（GPT-5.5）和 95%（Kimi-K2.6）。在成功检索的记忆中，60-89% 的评估场景中投毒记忆导致了攻击者预设的智能体动作。该工作揭示了持久记忆作为长期攻击面的安全风险，提醒开发者关注智能体记忆的安全隔离与验证机制。

items.title: Distance-Preserving Digests: A Primitive for BFT Consensus
items.summary: Every BFT consensus protocol uses collision-resistant hashes to compare validator state. Collision resistance destroys distance: two validators agreeing on 19 of 20 transactions produce unrelated hashes, indistinguishable from validators sharing nothing. This forces three design constraints across the BFT literature: validators must synchronize state before voting, agreement quality cannot be measured until votes are counted, and hierarchical committees must be large enough for independent BFT, limiting tree depth. This paper introduces distance-preserving transaction digests, a primitive that replaces collision-resistant hashes with commutative vector sums in 8-dimensional space. The primitive has three properties hashes lack: distance is proportional to disagreement, weighted means are exact, and set differences are identifiable via bloom filter diff. We demonstrate three applications: a two-phase BFT protocol (Proxima) that achieves single-round finality when validators agree; tree-structured consensus with groups of 10 validators (vs 128 in Ethereum), enabled because distance filtering replaces per-group BFT; and cross-shard consistency verification at 128 bytes per shard pair, replacing the per-transaction coordination of two-phase commit. Safety is proved: fewer than N/3 Byzantine validators cannot cause conflicting finalization, independent of Phase 1 clustering or tree topology. At N =100,000, Proxima Tree uses 2.2x fewer messages than HotStuff (a structural property unaffected by parallelism). Single-core finality is 0.9s vs 18s for HotStuff; multi-core BLS narrows but does not eliminate this gap.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于拜占庭容错（BFT）共识的距离保持事务摘要原语，旨在替代传统碰撞抵抗哈希。传统哈希会破坏距离：两个验证者若在20笔交易中同意19笔，其哈希值却完全不相关，与无共享交易时的情形无异。这导致BFT文献中三个设计约束：验证者必须在投票前同步状态、投票前无法衡量共识质量、分层委员会必须足够大以独立运行BFT，限制了树的深度。本文引入基于8维空间中交换向量和的摘要原语，具备哈希所缺乏的三个性质：距离与分歧成比例、加权均值精确、可通过布隆过滤器差分识别集合差异。作者展示了三个应用：两阶段BFT协议Proxima，当验证者达成一致时实现单轮终局性；树状共识，每组仅需10个验证者（以太坊需要128个），因距离过滤替代了每组的BFT；跨分片一致性验证，每对分片仅需128字节，替代了每笔交易的两阶段提交协调。安全性证明：少于N/3拜占庭验证者无法导致冲突终局，与第一阶段聚类或树拓扑无关。在N=100,000时，Proxima Tree的消息数比HotStuff少2.2倍（结构特性，不受并行影响）。单核终局时间0.9秒对比HotStuff的18秒；多核BLS缩小但未消除差距。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究提出了一种新颖的原语，有望显著提升BFT共识的效率与可扩展性，尤其在大规模验证者场景下。安全从业者应关注其潜在实际应用，如区块链共识优化。

items.title: Autonomous Intelligent Agents for Natural-Language-Driven Web Execution with Integrated Security Assurance
items.summary: Modern web test suites rot. A UI refactor breaks locators, a timing change causes race conditions, and within weeks developers abandon the suite entirely. This paper presents an AI-driven autonomous testing framework that addresses these failure modes through five integrated strategies - navigation reliability, context-aware selector generation, post-generation validation, smart wait injection, and failure learning - implemented over a containerised worker architecture that decouples orchestration from long-running browser execution. Evaluated across four production applications and 176 scenarios, the framework improves script generation success from 55% to 93%, achieves an 8x reduction in navigation failures, eliminates 80% of timing-related race conditions, and reduces test creation time by 75% compared to manual Selenium authoring. The framework extends naturally to security validation: testers describe attack scenarios in plain English - "try accessing another user's invoice" - which the agent converts to OWASP Top 10-aligned browser probes, detecting 85% of authentication bypass vulnerabilities and 95% of input validation flaws with false positive rates below 12%. Natural-language-driven security testing of this kind represents, to our knowledge, a novel contribution to the field.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于AI的自主测试框架，用于自然语言驱动的Web执行，并集成了安全保证。研究背景是现代Web测试套件因UI重构、时序变化等原因容易退化，导致开发人员放弃维护。框架通过五项集成策略解决这些问题：导航可靠性、上下文感知的选择器生成、生成后验证、智能等待注入和失败学习。系统基于容器化工作节点架构，将编排与长时间运行的浏览器执行解耦。在四个生产应用的176个场景中评估，脚本生成成功率从55%提升至93%，导航失败减少8倍，时序相关竞态条件消除80%，测试创建时间相比手动Selenium编写减少75%。框架自然扩展到安全验证：测试人员用自然语言描述攻击场景（如“尝试访问其他用户的发票”），代理将其转换为符合OWASP Top 10的浏览器探测，检测出85%的身份验证绕过漏洞和95%的输入验证缺陷，假阳性率低于12%。这种自然语言驱动的安全测试是本文的新颖贡献。适合AI安全、自动化测试、DevSecOps从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架将自然语言与安全验证结合，显著降低了安全测试的门槛，同时保持高检测率和低误报率，有望改变传统Web安全测试的实践。

items.title: MetaBackdoor: Exploiting Positional Encoding as a Backdoor Attack Surface in LLMs
items.summary: Backdoor attacks pose a serious security threat to large language models (LLMs), which are increasingly deployed as general-purpose assistants in safety- and privacy-critical applications. Existing LLM backdoors rely primarily on content-based triggers, requiring explicit modification of the input text. In this work, we show that this assumption is unnecessary and limiting. We introduce MetaBackdoor, a new class of backdoor attacks that exploits positional information as the trigger, without modifying textual content. Our key insight is that Transformer-based LLMs necessarily encode token positions to process ordered sequences. As a result, length-correlated positional structure is reflected in the model's internal computation and can be used as an effective non-content trigger signal. We demonstrate that even a simple length-based positional trigger is sufficient to activate stealthy backdoors. Unlike prior attacks, MetaBackdoor operates on visibly and semantically clean inputs and enables qualitatively new capabilities. We show that a backdoored LLM can be induced to disclose sensitive internal information, including proprietary system prompts, once a length condition is satisfied. We further demonstrate a self-activation scenario, where normal multi-turn interaction can move the conversation context into the trigger region and induce malicious tool-call behavior without attacker-supplied trigger text. In addition, MetaBackdoor is orthogonal to content-based backdoors and can be composed with them to create more precise and harder-to-detect activation conditions. Our results expand the threat model of LLM backdoors by revealing positional encoding as a previously overlooked attack surface. This challenges defenses that focus on detecting suspicious text and highlights the need for new defense strategies that explicitly account for positional triggers in modern LLM architectures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种针对大型语言模型（LLM）的新型后门攻击方法——MetaBackdoor。与现有依赖显式修改输入文本内容的触发器不同，MetaBackdoor 利用 Transformer 架构中固有的位置编码信息作为无内容触发器，无需改变任何词汇或语义。核心洞察在于：LLM 在处理序列时必然会编码 token 位置，因此与长度相关的位置结构会反映在模型内部计算中，可被用作有效且难以察觉的触发信号。论文展示了即使简单基于序列长度的位置触发器也能激活隐蔽后门。攻击者可以通过控制输入序列长度（例如在正常对话中逐渐增加上下文）来触发预设恶意行为，如泄露内部敏感信息（包括专有系统提示）或诱导执行非预期的工具调用。MetaBackdoor 与基于内容的传统后门正交，可组合使用以实现更精准、更难检测的激活条件。实验证明该攻击在多种 LLM 上有效，并展示了自激活场景：正常的多轮交互可将对话上下文自然推入触发区域，从而在不提供攻击者指定触发文本的情况下引发恶意行为。此项工作扩展了 LLM 后门的威胁模型，揭示了位置编码作为此前被忽视的攻击面，对现有依赖检测可疑文本的防御策略提出了挑战。适合 LLM 安全研究员、模型开发者和 SOC 分析师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示LLM位置编码可被利用为无文本后门触发器，突破传统内容检测防御，扩展攻击面，需安全社区重新评估防御策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响所有基于Transformer的LLM，特别是需要保护系统提示或工具调用的场景；攻击无需攻击者提供显式恶意输入，可通过正常交互触发，隐蔽性极强。

items.title: Talk is (Not) Cheap: A Taxonomy and Benchmark Coverage Audit for LLM Attacks
items.summary: We introduce a reusable framework for auditing whether LLM attack benchmarks collectively cover the threat surface: a 4$\times$6 Target $\times$ Technique matrix grounded in STRIDE, constructed from a 507-leaf taxonomy -- 401 data-populated and 106 threat-model-derived leaves -- of inference-time attacks extracted from 932 arXiv security studies (2023--2026). The matrix enables benchmark-external validation -- auditing collective coverage rather than individual benchmark consistency. Applying it to six public benchmarks reveals that the three primary frameworks (HarmBench, InjecAgent, AgentDojo) occupy non-overlapping cells covering at most 25\% of the matrix, while entire STRIDE threat categories (Service Disruption, Model Internals) lack any standardized evaluation, despite published attacks in these categories achieving 46$\times$ token amplification and 96\% attack success rates through mechanisms which no benchmark tests. The corpus of 2,521 unique attack groups further reveals pervasive naming fragmentation (up to 29 surface forms for a single attack) and heavy concentration in Safety \& Alignment Bypass, structural properties invisible at smaller scale. The taxonomy, attack records, and coverage mappings are released as extensible artifacts; as new benchmarks emerge, they can be mapped onto the same matrix, enabling the community to track whether evaluation gaps are closing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对大语言模型（LLM）推理时攻击的基准测试覆盖率不足问题，提出了一种可复用的审计框架。研究团队从932篇2023-2026年间的arXiv安全研究中提取了507个攻击分类叶节点（其中401个有数据填充，106个源自威胁模型推导），并基于STRIDE威胁建模方法构建了一个4×6的“目标×技术”矩阵。该矩阵支持对基准测试进行外部验证——即评估多个基准测试的整体覆盖率，而非单个基准测试的一致性。通过将矩阵应用于六个公开基准测试（HarmBench、InjecAgent、AgentDojo等），发现三个主要框架的测试单元互不重叠，且仅覆盖了矩阵最多25%的单元格；更严重的是，整个STRIDE威胁类别（如服务中断、模型内部）缺乏任何标准化评估，尽管已发表的攻击在这些类别中实现了46倍的令牌放大和96%的攻击成功率，而现有基准测试均未覆盖。此外，研究从2521个独特攻击组中发现了普遍的名称碎片化问题（单个攻击最多有29种表面形式），以及攻击集中在“安全与对齐绕过”领域。论文贡献包括：可扩展的分类体系、攻击记录和覆盖率映射，并由社区维护，以便新基准测试出现时映射到同一矩阵，追踪评估缺口是否缩小。该工作适合安全研究人员、大模型安全评估人员以及基准测试设计者阅读，有助于系统性地识别当前评估体系的盲区，推动更全面的LLM安全评估。

items.title: Veritas: A Semantically Grounded Agentic Framework for Memory Corruption Vulnerability Detection in Binaries
items.summary: Detecting memory corruption vulnerabilities in stripped binaries requires recovering object semantics, interprocedural propagation, and feasible triggers from low-level, lossy representations. Recent LLM-based approaches improve code understanding, but reliable detection still requires grounding in memory-relevant semantics and runtime feasibility evidence. We present Veritas, a semantically grounded framework for binary memory corruption vulnerability detection. Veritas combines a static slicer over RetDec-lifted LLVM IR, a dual-view LLM detector that reasons step by step over grounded flows using decompiled C and selective LLVM IR, and a multi-agent validator that checks hypotheses against debugger-visible artifacts and runtime evidence. The slicer reconstructs value-flow relations from LLVM-IR facts, including def-use, calls, returns, globals, and pointer operations, and emits compact witness-backed flow objects. The detector uses these artifacts to reason about control flow, bounds, and object correspondence without rediscovering whole-binary propagation. The validator confirms or rejects candidates through guided debugging, breakpoint inspection, and memory-checking oracles. We implement Veritas as a modular pipeline and evaluate it on a curated benchmark of real-world binary vulnerability cases. Veritas achieves 90\% recall. For false-positive assessment, we exhaustively validate and manually verify 623 detector candidates and audit additional candidates from larger cases. The exhaustive subset produces no false positives, while the additional audit identifies two confirmed false positives. In a real-world application, Veritas discovered a previously unknown Apple vulnerability that was confirmed and assigned a CVE. These results support semantic grounding as an operational design principle for practical binary vulnerability detection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出 Veritas，一个语义基础的多智能体框架，用于检测二进制文件中的内存损坏漏洞。研究背景是，在剥离符号的二进制文件中检测此类漏洞需要恢复对象语义、过程间传播以及可行的触发条件，而传统方法依赖底层有损表示，效果有限。近期基于 LLM 的方法提升了代码理解能力，但可靠检测仍需要基于内存相关语义和运行时可行性证据。Veritas 结合了三个组件：1）静态切片器，基于 RetDec 提升的 LLVM IR 重建值流关系，包括定义-使用、调用、返回、全局变量和指针操作，生成紧凑的见证支持流对象；2）双视图 LLM 检测器，利用反编译的 C 代码和选择性 LLVM IR，在基础流上逐步推理，避免重新发现整个程序传播；3）多智能体验证器，通过引导调试、断点检查和内存检查预言机确认或拒绝候选漏洞。研究团队在真实世界二进制漏洞基准测试上评估，Veritas 达到 90% 召回率；在假阳性评估中，对 623 个候选者进行穷举验证和手动审计，穷举子集无假阳性，额外审计发现两个确认假阳性。在实际应用中，Veritas 发现了一个之前未知的苹果漏洞，已确认并分配 CVE。该工作表明语义基础可作为实际二进制漏洞检测的操作性设计原则。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了一种结合静态分析、LLM 和多智能体验证的二进制漏洞检测新范式，在真实场景中发现了苹果未知漏洞并获 CVE，证明了将语义基础作为设计原则的有效性。

items.title: PickleFuzzer: A Case Study in Fuzzing for Discrepancies Between Python Pickle Implementations
items.summary: Python's native serialization protocol, pickle, is a powerful but insecure format for transferring untrusted data. It is frequently used, especially for saving machine learning models, despite known security challenges. While developers sometimes mitigate this risk by restricting imports during unpickling or using static and dynamic analysis tools, these approaches are error-prone and depend heavily on accurate interpretations of the Pickle Virtual Machine (PVM) opcodes. Discrepancies across Python's three native PVM modules can lead to incorrect detection of malicious payloads and undermine existing defenses. To efficiently and scalably identify discrepancies, we present PickleFuzzer, a custom generation-based fuzzer that identifies inconsistencies across pickle implementations. PickleFuzzer generates pickle objects, passes them to each implementation, and detects differences in thrown exceptions or changes to key internal states. It generates pickle objects using a grammar, which we developed to account for the missing pickle specification. It determines discrepancies by comparing the execution behaviors of each test implementation, rather than requiring a specification-derived oracle. PickleFuzzer detected 14 new discrepancies between the pickle implementations. Four discrepancies are critical and can be used to bypass security-critical scanning tools like those deployed on the popular model hosting platform, Hugging Face. We disclosed all findings to the Python Software Foundation for remediation, and additionally disclosed the security issues to a bug bounty platform and were awarded a $750 bounty. We demonstrate that differential testing is a viable approach for identifying security-relevant discrepancies in important pickle implementations, and our work can lead to promising future directions for finding deeper pickle bugs with more directed fuzzing.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Python的原生序列化协议pickle虽被广泛用于保存机器学习模型，但因安全风险常需通过限制导入或静态/动态分析来防御。然而，Python的三个原生pickle实现（如C语言版本和纯Python版本）对Pickle虚拟机（PVM）操作码的解释存在差异，导致防御工具可能漏检恶意负载。为了高效发现这些差异，本文提出了PickleFuzzer，一种基于生成的定制模糊测试工具。PickleFuzzer通过语法生成pickle对象，并传递给不同实现，比较执行过程中的异常或内部状态变化来检测差异，而非依赖标准规范。实验发现了14个新差异，其中4个关键差异可绕过Hugging Face等平台的安全扫描工具。作者已向Python软件基金会报告，并获得了750美元漏洞奖励。研究表明，差分测试是发现pickle实现中安全相关差异的有效方法，为未来定向模糊测试提供了方向。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了pickle实现间细微差异可被攻击者利用绕过安全扫描，对于使用pickle的AI模型托管平台和安全工具至关重要。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接威胁到依赖pickle安全扫描（如Hugging Face）的平台，可能导致恶意模型被误判为安全。

items.title: Analyzing Codes of Conduct for Online Safety in Video Games at Scale
items.summary: Online video games have become major online social spaces where users interact, compete, and create together. These spaces, however, expose users to a wide spectrum of online harms, including harassment, discrimination, inappropriate content, privacy breach, cheating, and more. The shape and severity of such harms vary across game design, mechanics, and community context. To mitigate these harms, game companies issue Codes of Conduct (CoCs) that articulate online safety rules and direct players to safety resources. However, it remains unclear how prevalent CoCs are, what safety, security and privacy violations they govern, and whether they meet growing regulatory and industry expectations. We develop and leverage CONDUCTIFY, a pipeline for identifying and analyzing CoCs at scale. Applied to Steam, the largest PC game marketplace, it located the available CoCs for 350 of the 9,586 multiplayer titles on Steam. We found that CoCs are more available among popular, adult-oriented, and community-driven games, while most multiplayer games operate without CoCs despite regulatory and industry recommendations. Although over 80% of the games with CoCs available consistently address traditional security and safety violations, their governance approaches vary substantially across types of violations. A further asymmetry emerges in specificity. Compared with harms related to gameplay mechanics, the articulations of interpersonal harm and the underage player safety are often less specific, despite their relevance to many game communities. Together, these results inform the improvement of online safety governance and CoC enforcement practices, and building better safety infrastructure for the community of players and developers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对大型多人在线游戏中行为准则（CoCs）的覆盖范围、内容特征和治理有效性展开大规模实证研究。在线游戏已成为用户互动、竞争和创造的主要社交空间，但同时也伴随着骚扰、歧视、不当内容、隐私泄露、作弊等多种网络伤害。游戏公司通过发布行为准则来阐明安全规则并引导玩家获取安全资源，然而业界对行为准则的普及程度、所涵盖的安全与隐私违规类型、以及是否满足监管和行业期望仍缺乏系统性了解。作者开发并应用了CONDUCTIFY管道，该管道能够自动化识别和分析游戏行为准则。研究以Steam平台为数据源，覆盖9,586款多人在线游戏，发现其中仅有350款游戏提供了可访问的行为准则。分析表明，行为准则在热门、面向成人以及社区驱动型游戏中更常见，但大多数多人在线游戏在缺乏行为准则的情况下运行，尽管监管和行业有相应建议。在内容方面，超过80%拥有行为准则的游戏一致性地针对传统安全违规（如作弊、骚扰）作出规定，但不同违规类型的治理方式差异显著。值得注意的是，与游戏机制相关的伤害相比，对人际伤害和未成年人安全保护的规定往往缺乏具体性，尽管这些伤害对许多游戏社区至关重要。研究结果揭示了当前在线安全治理的缺口，为改进行为准则的制定、执行以及构建更完善的玩家和开发者安全基础设施提供了实证依据和建议。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次大规模分析了游戏平台行为准则的现状和不足，为安全从业者评估和提升在线游戏安全治理策略提供了数据支撑，尤其对防范人际伤害和未成年人保护具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 研究成果可直接应用于游戏公司完善行为准则模板、平台安全审核流程，以及推动行业标准制定；也可迁移至其他在线社区（如社交媒体、元宇宙）的安全治理实践。

items.title: WARD: Adversarially Robust Defense of Web Agents Against Prompt Injections
items.summary: Web agents can autonomously complete online tasks by interacting with websites, but their exposure to open web environments makes them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks embedded in HTML content or visual interfaces. Existing guard models still suffer from limited generalization to unseen domains and attack patterns, high false positive rates on benign content, reduced deployment efficiency due to added latency at each step, and vulnerability to adversarial attacks that evolve over time or directly target the guard itself. To address these limitations, we propose WARD (Web Agent Robust Defense against Prompt Injection), a practical guard model for secure and efficient web agents. WARD is built on WARD-Base, a large-scale dataset with around 177K samples collected from 719 high-traffic URLs and platforms, and WARD-PIG, a dedicated dataset designed for prompt injection attacks targeting the guard model. We further introduce A3T, an adaptive adversarial attack training framework that iteratively strengthens WARD through a memory-based attacker and guard co-evolution process. Extensive experiments show that WARD achieves nearly perfect recall on out-of-distribution benchmarks, maintains low false positive rates to preserve agent utility, remains robust against guard-targeted and adaptive attacks under substantial distribution shifts, and runs efficiently in parallel with the agent without introducing additional latency.

llm_summary.summary_zh: Web 代理能够自主与网站交互完成在线任务，但开放环境使其易受嵌入在 HTML 或视觉界面中的提示注入攻击。现有守卫模型存在泛化能力差（对未见过的攻击模式效果不佳）、误报率高（影响正常任务）、部署延迟大（每步额外推理开销）以及对针对守卫本身的对抗攻击缺乏鲁棒性等问题。为此，本文提出 WARD (Web Agent Robust Defense against Prompt Injection)，一种实用且高效的守卫模型。WARD 构建于两个大规模数据集之上：WARD-Base 包含约 177K 样本，来自 719 个高流量 URL 和平台，覆盖良性交互；WARD-PIG 专门收集针对守卫模型的提示注入攻击样本。此外，作者提出 A3T (Adaptive Adversarial Attack Training) 框架，通过记忆驱动的攻击者与守卫共同进化过程，迭代式强化 WARD 的鲁棒性。A3T 模拟不断演化的自适应攻击，使守卫在分布漂移下依然保持性能。大量实验表明，WARD 在分布外基准上实现了接近完美的召回率（几乎检测所有攻击），同时保持极低的误报率以确保代理效用；面对直接针对守卫模型的自适应攻击时仍保持鲁棒；并且由于架构设计，WARD 可与代理并行运行而不引入额外延迟，适合实际部署。该研究为 Web 代理安全设定了新基准，并为防御提示注入提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提示注入是当前 LLM 应用面临的主要安全威胁之一，尤其在 Web 代理场景中攻击面大、防护困难。WARD 首次系统性地解决泛化性、误报率、延迟和对抗鲁棒性四大挑战，提出的数据集和训练框架为后续研究及工业部署提供了重要基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升基于 LLM 的 Web 代理（如浏览器自动化、智能助手）的安全性；其数据集和训练方法可迁移至其他自主系统（如 API 代理、多步任务链）的提示注入防御场景。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进，考虑在安全智能体或 LLM 应用网关中引入类似 WARD 的离线守卫机制。

items.title: Toward Securing AI Agents Like Operating Systems
items.summary: Autonomous agents based on large language models (LLMs) are rapidly emerging as a general-purpose technology, with recent systems such as OpenClaw extending their capabilities through broad tool use, third-party skills, and deeper integration into user environments. At the same time, these agentic systems introduce substantial security risks by combining unconstrained capabilities with access to sensitive user data. In this work, we investigate the security of LLM-based agents through the lens of operating systems. We argue that both face strikingly similar challenges in isolating resources, separating privileges, and mediating communication. Guided by this perspective, we survey the current landscape of open-source agents, derive a unified agent architecture, and systematically analyze potential attack vectors. To validate this analysis, we conduct a case study evaluating four widely used OpenClaw-like agents. Even under modest attacker capabilities, we find that several protection mechanisms fail in practice and that secure operation requires detailed system knowledge and careful configuration. However, we also observe that while some agentic capabilities remain insecure by design, many vulnerabilities can be mitigated using well-established techniques from operating system security. We conclude with a set of recommendations for the secure design of agentic systems.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文从操作系统的安全设计视角系统性地分析了基于大语言模型（LLM）的自主智能体（agent）的安全问题。随着OpenClaw等系统通过广泛工具调用、第三方技能集成和深度嵌入用户环境，智能体能力迅速增强，但也引入了严重安全风险，因为其不受约束的能力与敏感数据访问相结合。作者指出，智能体系统与操作系统在资源隔离、权限分离和通信中介等方面面临高度相似的挑战。为此，他们首先调研了当前开源智能体生态，提取出统一的智能体架构，并系统分析了潜在攻击向量。通过一个针对四个广泛使用的OpenClaw-like智能体的案例研究，即使在攻击者能力有限的情况下，多个保护机制在实践中仍然失效，安全运行需要详细的系统知识和精细配置。然而，研究也发现，尽管某些智能体能力在设计上存在固有安全缺陷，但许多漏洞可以通过操作系统安全中行之有效的技术（如沙箱、最小权限等）得到缓解。最后，作者为智能体系统的安全设计提出了一系列建议。本文适合智能体开发者、安全研究人员及对LLM系统安全感兴趣的工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次系统地将操作系统安全原理应用于LLM智能体安全分析，揭示了当前开源智能体的普遍脆弱性，并为后续安全加固提供了实用方向。

items.title: Do Coding Agents Understand Least-Privilege Authorization?
items.summary: As coding agents gain access to shells, repositories, and user files, least-privilege authorization becomes a prerequisite for safe deployment: an agent should receive enough authority to complete the task, without unnecessary authority that exposes sensitive surfaces. To study whether current models can infer this boundary themselves, we first introduce permission-boundary inference, where a model maps a task instruction and terminal environment to a file-level read/write/execute policy, and AuthBench, a benchmark of 120 realistic terminal tasks with human-reviewed permission labels and executable validators for utility and attack outcomes. AuthBench shows that authorization is not a simple conservative-versus-permissive calibration problem: frontier models often omit permissions required by the execution chain while also granting unused or sensitive accesses. Increasing inference-time reasoning does not resolve this mismatch. Instead, each model moves toward a model-specific authorization attractor: more reasoning makes it more consistent in its own failure mode, whether broad-but-exposed or tight-but-brittle. This suggests that direct policy generation is the bottleneck, because a single generation must both discover all necessary accesses and reject all unnecessary ones. We therefore propose Sufficiency-Tightness Decomposition, which first generates a coverage-oriented policy by forward-simulating the task and then audits each granted entry for grounding and sensitivity. Across tested models, this decomposition improves sensitive-task success by up to 15.8% on tightness-biased models while reducing attack success across all evaluated models.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究编码智能体（coding agents）在执行任务时是否能够自主理解并实现最小权限授权。最小权限原则要求智能体只获得完成任务所必需的最小权限，避免授予可能被攻击的敏感权限。作者首先定义了“权限边界推断”（Permission-Boundary Inference）任务：给定任务指令和终端环境，模型需要输出一个文件级的读/写/执行策略。为此构建了 AuthBench 基准，包含120个真实终端任务，每个任务附有人工审核的权限标签以及可执行的验证器，用于评估实用性和攻击结果。实验表明，现有前沿模型（如GPT-4、Claude等）在授权方面表现不佳：要么遗漏执行链所需的权限，要么授予多余或敏感的权限。增加推理计算量（如链式思考）并不能解决此问题，反而使模型向自身特定的“授权吸引子”收敛——更多推理使其在自身失败模式上更加一致，无论是“宽泛但暴露”还是“严格但脆弱”。这表明直接策略生成是瓶颈，因为单次生成既要发现所有必要访问，又要拒绝所有不必要访问。为此，作者提出“充分性-紧致性分解”（Sufficiency-Tightness Decomposition）：首先生成一个覆盖导向的策略（通过前向模拟任务），然后审计每个授予的条目，检查其是否被任务上下文支持以及是否敏感。实验显示，在不同模型上，该分解方法在紧致性偏好的模型上使敏感任务成功率提升最高达15.8%，并在所有评估模型上降低了攻击成功率。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 本文揭示了编码智能体在安全授权方面的系统性缺陷，并提出了可落地的分解方法，对构建安全可靠的自主编程助手具有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该研究直接影响到基于LLM的编码智能体的安全部署，尤其是需要访问文件系统、执行命令的场景。

items.title: Can Visual Mamba Improve AI-Generated Image Detection? An In-Depth Investigation
items.summary: In recent years, computer vision has witnessed remarkable progress, fueled by the development of innovative architectures such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), diffusion-based architectures, Vision Transformers (ViTs), and, more recently, Vision-Language Models (VLMs). This progress has undeniably contributed to creating increasingly realistic and diverse visual content. However, such advancements in image generation also raise concerns about potential misuse in areas such as misinformation, identity theft, and threats to privacy and security. In parallel, Mamba-based architectures have emerged as versatile tools for a range of image analysis tasks, including classification, segmentation, medical imaging, object detection, and image restoration, in this rapidly evolving field. However, their potential for identifying AI-generated images remains relatively unexplored compared to established techniques. This study provides a systematic evaluation and comparative analysis of Vision Mamba models for AI-generated image detection. We benchmark multiple Vision Mamba variants against representative CNNs, ViTs, and VLM-based detectors across diverse datasets and synthetic image sources, focusing on key metrics such as accuracy, efficiency, and generalizability across diverse image types and generative models. Through this comprehensive analysis, we aim to elucidate Vision Mamba's strengths and limitations relative to established methodologies in terms of applicability, accuracy, and efficiency in detecting AI-generated images. Overall, our findings highlight both the promise and current limitations of Vision Mamba as a component in systems designed to distinguish authentic from AI-generated visual content. This research is crucial for enhancing detection in an age where distinguishing between real and AI-generated content is a major challenge.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文系统评估了Vision Mamba架构在AI生成图像检测任务中的性能。随着图像生成技术（如CNN、GAN、扩散模型、ViT及视觉-语言模型）的飞速发展，生成图像的真实感和多样性大幅提升，同时也带来了虚假信息、身份盗窃等安全威胁。Mamba作为一种新兴的序列建模架构，已在图像分类、分割、医学成像等任务中展现出潜力，但用于检测AI生成图像的研究尚不充分。作者对多种Vision Mamba变体进行了基准测试，并与代表性的CNN、ViT和基于VLM的检测器进行对比，涵盖多个数据集和不同的生成模型来源。评估指标包括准确率、效率和跨生成类型的泛化能力。实验结果表明，Vision Mamba在检测AI生成图像方面既有潜力也存在局限性，为后续研究提供了重要参考。本文适合计算机视觉、安全检测领域的研究者和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 区分真实与AI生成内容日益重要，Vision Mamba作为新兴架构的检测能力评估有助于推动更高效、稳健的检测方案。

items.why_it_matters: 区分真实与AI生成内容日益重要，Vision Mamba作为新兴架构的检测能力评估有助于推动更高效、稳健的检测方案。

items.title: Known By Their Actions: Fingerprinting LLM Browser Agents via UI Traces
items.summary: As LLM-based agents increasingly browse the web on users' behalf, a natural question arises: can websites passively identify which underlying model powers an agent? Doing so would represent a significant security risk, enabling targeted attacks tailored to known model vulnerabilities. Across 14 frontier LLMs and four web environments spanning information retrieval and shopping tasks, we show that an agent's actions and interaction timings, captured via a passive JavaScript tracker, are sufficient to identify the underlying model with up to 96\% F1. We formalise this attack surface by demonstrating that classifiers trained on agent actions generalise across model sizes and families. We further show that strong classifiers can be trained from few interaction traces and that agent identity can be inferred early within an episode. Injecting randomised timing delays between actions substantially degrades classifier performance, but does not provide robust protection: a classifier retrained on delayed traces largely recovers performance. We release our harness and a labelled corpus of agent traces \href{https://github.com/KabakaWilliam/known_actions}{here}.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了一种新型安全威胁：如何被动识别驱动浏览器代理的底层大语言模型（LLM）。研究者通过记录代理在网页上的交互动作（如点击、滚动、输入）及其时间间隔，利用 JavaScript 跟踪器捕获这些行为轨迹，训练分类器来识别模型身份。在 14 个前沿 LLM（包括 GPT-4、Claude、Llama 等）和四个不同网页环境（信息检索、购物任务）中，该方法达到了最高 96% 的 F1 分数。研究表明，基于代理行为训练的分类器能够跨模型规模和家族泛化；仅需少量交互轨迹即可训练强分类器，且能在一个执行片段的早期识别出模型。虽然注入随机时间延迟可以降低分类器性能，但针对延迟轨迹重新训练后，分类器基本能恢复识别能力。论文公开了实验框架和标注数据集。该工作揭示了 LLM 代理面临的新攻击面：恶意网站可根据代理行为特征判断其底层模型，从而发起针对性攻击（如利用已知模型漏洞）。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 首次揭示了通过无源行为特征即可精确识别LLM代理背后的模型，为针对性攻击打开新通道，防御者需重视该隐蔽威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响所有部署LLM驱动的浏览器代理的场景，如自动化测试、个人助手、爬虫等，攻击者可据此定制漏洞利用。

items.why_it_matters: 首次揭示了通过无源行为特征即可精确识别LLM代理背后的模型，为针对性攻击打开新通道，防御者需重视该隐蔽威胁。
